in_marathi.name: Aum
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The sound of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aum हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The syllable ‘Aum’ is the sound of the Universe, according to Hindu scriptures. It is the primal sound, the cosmic sound, and the sacred sound of creation. The ‘Omkar’ or ‘Aum’ mantra is believed to connect an individual to the divine consciousness.

in_bengali.name: Aum
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The sound of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aum একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The syllable ‘Aum’ is the sound of the Universe, according to Hindu scriptures. It is the primal sound, the cosmic sound, and the sacred sound of creation. The ‘Omkar’ or ‘Aum’ mantra is believed to connect an individual to the divine consciousness.
